local_review.finding_body: All three required JavaCV matrix jobs failed in javaTest because tests selected an OpenCV backend whose native highgui library required libgtk-x11-2.0.so.0, while the projector scenario assumed a headful graphics environment. Coordinate tests must pass the required lanes while preserving meaningful public-API behavior. §FS-repository-functional-spec.5.2 §FS-test-contract.1.3
local_review.finding_title: Avoid host GUI dependencies in JavaCV backend-selection tests
local_review.fix_note: Reworked CameraDevice selector coverage to use a separate-package deterministic FrameGrabber with File, String, and boxed-Integer constructors; kept strict backend discovery through the available FFmpeg backend; and asserted ProjectorDevice's supported headless behavior on headless hosts. Regenerated and split metadata and refreshed stats. Verified current-defaults on latest GraalVM, future-defaults-all on latest GraalVM, current-defaults on GraalVM 25, and checkMetadataFiles, checkstyle, spotlessCheck, validateIndexFiles, and validateLibraryStats.
local_review.review_comment: Workflow run 38267536058 failed all three org.bytedeco:javacv:1.5.12 jobs during javaTest: OpenCV backend initialization required the unavailable libgtk-x11-2.0.so.0, backend selection returned null, and ProjectorDevice construction failed on the headless runner. I repaired the contribution-local tests, regenerated and split their metadata, refreshed stats, and reviewed the complete resulting diff. The contribution remains scoped to one coordinate, uses only reachability-metadata.json, has no scaffold, version pin, Native Image skip, tolerated Native Image failure, package bypass, or build/run flag, and reports 34/41 dynamic-access calls covered (82.93%), above the new-library gate. The repaired tree is ready.
